mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine a world where sprawling cities rise from the jungle, rivers are shaped by human hands, and bustling marketplaces echo with the sounds of thousands of voices—all long before Columbus ever dreamed of a westward voyage. Welcome to a journey that challenges everything we thought we knew about the Americas before European contact. Together, we're about to peel back centuries of myth and uncover a story that's far richer and more complex than the old textbooks ever let on. Inspired by the discoveries in 1491: New Revelations of the Americas Before Columbus by Charles C. Mann, we'll step into a world where indigenous civilizations rivaled the greatest cities of the Old World, engineered their environments with breathtaking skill, and built societies filled with innovation and resilience. Get ready to wander through vibrant markets in Tenochtitlan, explore the intricate agricultural marvels of the Amazon, and navigate the webs of alliances and rivalries that shaped entire continents. As we uncover these hidden stories, you'll start to see the Americas—and their first peoples—in a whole new light. So, let's explore together, and discover just how extraordinary the world really was before Columbus set sail.
